visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a red-branded booth for '小小PETIT' featuring rows of colorful nail polish bottles. Two young female staff members stand behind the counter, smiling at the camera. The background shows a busy exhibition ceiling with industrial lighting. (2) A fast-paced montage shows a crowd of people running through an exhibition hall towards the camera as the event doors open. The lighting is bright and industrial. (3) Close-up shots show the young staff members applying nail polish to customers' fingernails. One girl focuses intently on a small bottle while the other talks to a client. (4) The scene shifts to a warmly lit restaurant where the same girls are seen eating hotpot and various dishes. They appear tired but happy. (5) A brief shot shows one of the girls lying in a white bed with a teddy bear, looking exhausted. (6) Back at the exhibition, the camera captures a long, winding queue of people waiting to enter. The girls are seen yawning and looking fatigued while still attending to customers. (7) The video concludes with more shots of the crowded booth, various close-ups of product bottles, and handwritten messages on a board. The lighting remains consistent within each environment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Event Activity Compilation -> Behind-the-scenes Struggles -> Brand Reflection/Gratitude.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for the nail polish brand '小小PETIT' during the Creative Expo Taiwan. It emphasizes the massive popularity of the booth, the dedication of the young staff members despite their exhaustion and long working hours, and expresses gratitude to customers for their support.
